$comment: French/English display overlay DECISION-0070 for the ius privatum bridge dictionary. Not compiled into CLIR. Working labels stay ru-KZ.

Causa.text: claim as the ground of the dispute: contract, delict, property, succession — one contested relation between two persons

ConsumptumExclusum.text: a remedy consumed by a former contest is excluded

ExclusioSuperDationem.text: exclusion of the remedy prevails over its grant: exceptio against intentio

IUS_PRIVATUM_MODEL.text: bridge dictionary of right and action (ius privatum), a formalised doctrine of comparative private law

IusEfficax.text: the right is effective when the remedy belongs to the claimant

IusNudum.text: an obligation without a remedy is a bare right

IusNudumExclusione.text: an obligation whose remedy is excluded is a bare right

Persona.text: person of private law: claimant, defendant, owner, debtor, creditor, heir

RemediumCompetitDatum.text: the remedy given by the legal order belongs to the claimant

RemediumExclusumTollitIus.text: an excluded remedy takes away the effectiveness of the right

RemediumSineIurePersonale.text: a personal remedy without the defendant's obligation is protection without a right

RemediumSineIureReale.text: a real remedy without the claimant's ownership is protection without a right

Res.text: thing: object of possession, ownership or claim

TransitAdHeredem.text: the remedy that passes to the heir belongs to the claimant's heir

TransitContraHeredem.text: the remedy that passes against the heir belongs to the claimant against the defendant's heir

actio_nata_ante_annos.text: the claim arose (the right of action opened) that many full years before the day of the dispute; the term is given as a duration, not a date, so one case can be read at any date of the link's law

animal_domini.text: the animal belongs to this person

bona_fides.text: the acquirer is in good faith: he did not know and could not know that the transferor had no right to alienate

causa_de_re.text: the claim is directed at this thing

causa_ex_contractu.text: the claim arose from a contract

causa_ex_delicto.text: the claim arose from a delict

contractus.text: the debtor bound himself toward the creditor by the contract underlying the claim

damnum_ab_animali.text: the animal caused harm to the victim

damnum_datum.text: the person caused harm to the victim by an unlawful act

depositum.text: the thing was given in deposit

dominium.text: the person is owner of the thing under the law of this code

dominus_originarius.text: the person was owner of the thing before the events of the case — the starting point from which the code counts the transfer of the right

famulus.text: the person is another's employee, servant or préposé and acted in the performance of the functions entrusted

filius.text: the person is the son or daughter of another

furtum.text: the person stole the thing from the owner

heres_est.text: the person is heir of the deceased under the law of this code

in_potestate.text: the person is in the power of the householder (son, slave) — a category of Roman law

ius_efficax.text: the right is effective: the remedy is given and not excluded

ius_nudum.text: bare right: the debtor is bound, but the creditor has no remedy

iusta_causa_possessionis.text: possession was acquired by just title (sale, gift, succession), not by seizure

obligatio.text: the debtor is bound toward the creditor on this claim

pactum_de_non_petendo.text: the creditor informally agreed with the debtor not to sue

pactum_de_petendo_postea.text: the parties later agreed that suit was allowed: the earlier pact not to sue is revoked

pecunia_non_numerata.text: the loan money was not actually delivered (not counted out)

petitio.text: the claimant brings a claim against the defendant — the contested relation the question is about

petitio_de_re.text: the claim is directed at a thing: the claimant revendicates it as his or demands its delivery

possessio.text: the person possesses the thing under the law of this code

possessio_continua_annos.text: the person has possessed the thing continuously for that many full years on the day of the dispute

possessor.text: the person actually possesses the thing on the day of the dispute

pretium_solutum.text: the buyer paid the price: the acquisition is for value

remedium_competit.text: the remedy belongs to the claimant against the defendant: it was given to him, or passed to him or against him by succession

remedium_consumptum.text: the remedy is consumed by a former contest on the same matter

remedium_datur.text: the legal order gives the claimant a remedy against the defendant on this claim

remedium_exclusum.text: the remedy is excluded: by exception, consumption by contest, prescription, or the defendant's immunity

remedium_in_personam.text: personal remedy: the claimant requires the defendant to give, to do or to provide

remedium_in_rem.text: real remedy: the claimant revendicates the thing as his

remedium_perpetuum.text: the remedy is not limited in time

remedium_poenale.text: the remedy pursues a penalty, not only reparation

remedium_sine_iure.text: remedy without a substantive right: the claimant is neither owner nor creditor under this code, yet obtains protection

remedium_temporale.text: the remedy is limited in time

remedium_transit_ad_heredem.text: the remedy passes to the claimant's heir

remedium_transit_contra_heredem.text: the remedy passes against the defendant's heir

res_a_domino_tradita.text: the owner himself delivered the thing to this person (deposit, use, sale): it left his possession by his will

res_domino_ablata.text: the thing left the owner's possession against his will: stolen or lost

res_iudicata_de_eadem_re.text: a judgment has already been given on the same claim between the same parties

res_mancipi.text: a thing among the res mancipi (Italic land, slaves, draft animals, rustic servitudes) — a category of Roman law; irrelevant to the other codes

res_non_reddita.text: the depositary did not restore the thing on demand

stipulatio_de_mutuo.text: the loan is evidenced by a promise (stipulation, note, contract) to repay the sum

traditio.text: the thing was actually handed over

venditio.text: the seller sold the thing to the buyer (the contract of sale is formed)
